mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saving_product (financial_institution_id,product_code,product_name,join_method,join_target,join_restriction,special_condition,maturity_interest,max_limit,notice,disclosure_month,disclosure_start_date,disclosure_end_date,submitted_at) VALUES (#{financialInstitutionId},#{productCode},#{productName},#{joinMethod},#{joinTarget},#{joinRestriction},#{specialCondition},#{maturityInterest},#{maxLimit},#{notice},#{disclosureMonth},#{disclosureStartDate},#{disclosureEndDate},#{submittedAt}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE saving_product_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(saving_product_id),product_name=new.product_name,join_method=new.join_method,join_target=new.join_target,join_restriction=new.join_restriction,special_condition=new.special_condition,maturity_interest=new.maturity_interest,max_limit=new.max_limit,notice=new.notice,disclosure_month=new.disclosure_month,disclosure_start_date=new.disclosure_start_date,disclosure_end_date=new.disclosure_end_date,submitted_at=new.submitted_at

INSERT INTO saving_option (saving_product_id,interest_rate_type,reserve_type,save_term,base_interest_rate,max_interest_rate) VALUES (#{productId},#{interestRateType},#{reserveType},#{saveTerm},#{baseInterestRate},#{maxInterestRate}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_interest_rate=new.base_interest_rate,max_interest_rate=new.max_interest_rate
mapper.select: SELECT sp.saving_product_id productId,fi.financial_institution_name institutionName,sp.product_name productName,MAX(o.max_interest_rate) maxInterestRate,sp.max_limit maxLimit,sp.join_method joinMethod FROM saving_product sp JOIN financial_institution fi ON fi.financial_institution_id=sp.financial_institution_id JOIN saving_option o ON o.saving_product_id=sp.saving_product_id GROUP BY sp.saving_product_id,fi.financial_institution_name,sp.product_name,sp.max_limit,sp.join_method ORDER BY maxInterestRate DESC,productId ASC

SELECT sp.saving_product_id productId,fi.financial_institution_name institutionName,sp.product_name productName,sp.join_method joinMethod,sp.join_target joinTarget,sp.join_restriction joinRestriction,sp.special_condition specialCondition,sp.maturity_interest maturityInterest,sp.max_limit maxLimit,sp.notice notice,sp.disclosure_month disclosureMonth,sp.disclosure_start_date disclosureStartDate,sp.disclosure_end_date disclosureEndDate,fpl.product_page_url productPageUrl FROM saving_product sp JOIN financial_institution fi ON fi.financial_institution_id=sp.financial_institution_id LEFT JOIN financial_product_link fpl ON fpl.financial_institution_id=sp.financial_institution_id AND fpl.product_type='SAVING' AND fpl.product_code=sp.product_code AND fpl.link_status='ACTIVE' WHERE sp.saving_product_id=#{productId}

SELECT saving_option_id optionId,interest_rate_type interestRateType,reserve_type reserveType,save_term saveTerm,base_interest_rate baseInterestRate,max_interest_rate maxInterestRate FROM saving_option WHERE saving_product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY save_term,reserve_type,interest_rate_type
